title: Health & Wellbeing
why-ula-meta-description: Why ULA? The story behind ULA MOVE – from the first movement programs in Belarus to today's therapeutic health concept.
why-ula-intro-lead: ULA has been part of my journey since I founded my first business in Belarus in 2010 and is closely connected to both my personal and professional development.
why-ula-name-after: It is derived from the Russian word
why-ula-origin-story: I was given this nickname because I brought a lot of energy and movement with me, got things going and organized processes. Like a spinning top: lively, dynamic and constantly in motion – yet always organized around a stable center. This image still reflects much of what shapes my work today:
why-ula-center-statement: Movement, change and development – without losing your own center.
why-ula-development: Over the years, ULA has continued to evolve as well: from my first services focused on movement and training to a broader therapeutic health concept that now brings together physiotherapy, respiratory therapy, movement and body awareness.
why-ula-continuity: Like a spinning top, ULA keeps moving and evolving – while the central idea remains the same:
why-ula-health-statement: For me, health does not mean standing still, but having the ability to realign yourself again and again.

why-ula-today-intro-before: Today, ULA MOVE is a therapeutic health concept that combines
why-ula-today-intro-emphasis: physiotherapy, movement, breathing and health literacy
why-ula-today-needs-before: People come to me because something is no longer working well:
why-ula-today-needs-emphasis: pain, physical limitations, exhaustion, reduced resilience or the feeling that they are no longer truly at ease in their own body.
why-ula-today-whole-person: It is not only about treating individual symptoms. I look at the person as a whole: their complaints, their history, their everyday life and the connections that influence their health.
why-ula-today-path-before: This forms the basis for an individual path – from
physio-group1-desc:
e.g. COPD, asthma, emphysema, pulmonary fibrosis, pneumonia (during recovery), long COVID, post-viral conditions, chronic cough, dyspnea, and functional breathing disorders  
(focus: reflexive breathing therapy)
physio-group2-desc:
e.g. back and joint pain, after surgery, functional imbalances, as well as people with high physical or psychological stress
Goal: pain reduction, improved sleep quality, regulation of the nervous system, and better quality of life in everyday life.
physio-desc-short: For those who perform a lot and rarely rest. This treatment combines manual techniques, breathing work, and targeted regeneration to relieve tension, regain energy, and calm the nervous system. Scientifically grounded and mindfully applied for deep recovery, clear energy, and lightness in the body.
physio-desc: Targeted manual therapy for people under high physical or mental stress. When pain, tension or exhaustion dominate daily life and there is little time for recovery, this therapy helps restore energy and freedom of movement in a short time. Through precise manual techniques, focused breathing work and individually tailored strategies, the nervous system calms down, muscles release, and regeneration accelerates. Whether in professional sports or demanding work environments - the body gains space to release stress, activate its energy reserves, and return to balance. A holistic approach combining evidence-based physiotherapy, manual work, and modern regeneration techniques - for measurable results and lasting wellbeing.
physio-private: For private patients with a prescription only.
training-desc: For prevention, recovery & inner balance. Individual, medically based training for everyone who wants to strengthen their health, whether preventively or with existing physical limitations. Through personal sessions or small group work, movement, breath, and body awareness create space, so your body feels strong, free, and alive again.
